posts.zh:
dsh-browser-fs 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4b9cf3dc48c0ac1eb7b1.html
posts.en:
dsh-browser-fs is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4b9cf3dc48c0ac1eb7b1.html
